name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with no glow. This guarantees visibility for users with low vision or in bright light, especially on mobile where glow can blur edges. The trade-off is a slightly bolder ring that may feel heavier in minimalist designs, but accessibility demands clarity over aesthetics.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on patterned or high-contrast backgrounds—users with low vision or cognitive disabilities may perceive it as part of the pattern. Test with a checkerboard pattern at 50% zoom on mobile; if the ring disappears or blends, switch to a 2px ring with a 2px outer glow at 8:1 contrast.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 2px focus ring with a 1px outer glow at 20% opacity, achieving 7:1 contrast. This balances crisp visibility on patterned backgrounds with reduced visual noise—glow prevents blending while the thin ring keeps minimalist designs intact. Trade-off: glow may slightly blur edges on high-contrast screens, but testing shows it’s negligible compared to the risk of invisibility on complex backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: Glow at 20% opacity still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds—users with low vision or cognitive disabilities may miss it entirely. A 2px ring with a 2px outer stroke at 7:1 contrast (no glow) guarantees visibility without blur or blending. Test with a checkerboard at 50% zoom on mobile; if the ring remains visible, adopt it—no glow needed.
